title: FEEL THE DROP EDM Entity Dictionary Addendum Candidate — 2026-08-04 Recall Audit
scope: Conservative candidate additions supported by the 2026-08-04 123-article recall audit and independent or official evidence of sustained EDM/electronic-music relevance.

usage_policy.english: Preserve exact capitalization, spacing, punctuation, and accents in `en`.
usage_policy.korean_established: ko_status=established: use `ko` as the Korean output only when a settled Korean notation was independently verified.
usage_policy.korean_none: ko_status=none: NO settled Korean notation was verified. Keep the English form as-is. NEVER invent a Korean transliteration.
usage_policy.ko_avoid: Incorrect Korean notations that must never be output.
usage_policy.aliases_en: Accepted input variants for matching. Do not use as output.
usage_policy.weight: Entity-matching weight follows the existing dictionary convention.
usage_policy.candidate_verification: Every candidate requires evidence beyond appearance in the audited one-day batch; evidence URLs are documented in the companion audit report.
